topic: Compilation of Erling Haaland's funny public moments: trolling tourists, walking Manchester streets, dressing as Joker and Santa
hook: Young fan clip with HAALAND label, then Haaland hooded in car with blurred 'Hater'
subtitle_style: bold white all-caps captions with black outline, bottom-centre; yellow/pink highlighted key words; yellow hand-drawn arrow labels (HAALAND, Hater)
reaction_overlays: yellow outline glow cutout, arrows, text labels, photo-in-frame inserts, blurred faces, Nost FC watermark
transition_summary: Fast hard cuts, 40 detected cuts in 60s (about 6.5 cuts/10s), bursts of 0.2-0.5s cuts around 43-56s; clips switch between phone footage and posed shots
audio_note: English voice-over summary ('From getting kicked out of the bar to surprising his haters outside...') plus original audio from clips

reuse_segments.what: Street/prank phone clips and social video
reuse_segments.how_to_reuse: Third-party social clips; needs clearance or recreate staged street-prank scenes with generated/actor footage
